limits: The instrumented window starts at server Social session initialization and ends at GameOver; it includes Waiting and all later phases, not Exploration alone.
The latest 1024 samples determine p95; maximum spans all recorded samples. FixedUpdate count is not the NGO network tick rate.
CPU time covers the measured server window, relative to one logical core. Peak working set is a process-lifetime high-water mark.

Social payload counts include only instrumented Social protobuf payload bytes; they exclude RPC/NGO/UDP headers, transforms, spawns and Standard communication. Their scoped byte rate is not full UDP throughput.
No packet capture, packet rate, RTT, physical input latency, native client FPS or displayed frame timing was measured.
Recipients are independently anonymized and sorted by aggregate counts; no actor/session/role/life state or identity mapping is published.
Performance instrumentation does not itself prove native-input or model gameplay acceptance.

server.payload_scope: social protobuf payloads only; excludes RPC/NGO/UDP headers, transforms, spawn and Standard communication
server.percentile_window: latest 1024 samples; maximum covers all samples
